_comment: Per-cart manifest for the walkable diorama. See carts/voxel-killer-bunny.lua.
name: voxel killer bunny
controls: the terraces are four voxels up and the plateau is eight: both need the jump
watch the drop shadow to judge where you will land
the river only slows you down
_camera: Three-quarter view from off the near-LEFT corner, set by hand with the shell's view control rather than derived: 46 degrees of azimuth, 31.5 of elevation, 241 out. The side is not a free choice -- the HUD boards are drawn on a y slice, so screen-right has to run along +x or their legends read backwards -- but the amount of swing is, and at 46 degrees the boards sit at a 29 degree tilt and are foreshortened to about seven tenths of their length. That is the trade this angle makes for showing both flanks of the island. Note the framing is deliberately tight: at fov 37 the slab's left corner falls about a tenth of a frame outside the left edge and the near corner grazes the bottom. fov 41 would contain the whole slab if that is ever wanted. Any of this can be overridden per-run with ?cam=x,y,z&tgt=x,y,z&fov=n, or turned with the mouse and kept with the lock-view box.
_groundZ: Pinned to the lawn. Auto-derivation would find it anyway, but the drop shadow is how you read the bunny's height while it is in the air, and a jump that lands on a terrace must not be the moment the plane moves.
